scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:yaml && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:oxfmt:check && pnpm run format:toml:check && pnpm run format:lua:check && pnpm run format:python:check && pnpm run format:shell:check
scripts.format:fish:check: uv run pre-commit run fish-check --hook-stage manual --all-files

scripts.format:python:check: uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.format:sh:check: uv run pre-commit run shfmt-check --hook-stage manual --all-files
scripts.format:shell: pnpm run format:fish && pnpm run format:sh
